label: Auto
description: Traces your image with {candidates}, and keeps the cleanest result that is as faithful as the best. Start here.

label: Balanced
description: Gradients, shadows, strokes and overlaps all reconstructed. The most faithful all-rounder.

label: Logo & icon
description: Merges harder and fits whole shapes, for a small, clean, hand-editable file. Best where the mark matters more than the last half-pixel.

label: Detailed illustration
description: Keeps subtler colour steps and more gradient stops, and fits a little tighter. For illustration where soft shading matters.

label: Simplified
description: Fewest shapes; the cleanest on busy art and soft shadows. Skips stroke, overlap and shadow recovery and merges hard.

label: Flat & poster
description: A style choice, not a quality setting: solid colours only, no gradients and no filters. Also the safest file for an old importer. Auto never picks it.

label: Cut file
description: An output format, not a quality setting: shapes that never overlap and no filters, for plotters and cutting machines. Auto never picks it.
